label: Extended Ambedkar’s insight that endogamy is the essence of caste into feminist historical theory
description: Drawing on Ambedkar’s 1916 Castes in India, Chakravarti demonstrated how controlling women’s sexuality through endogamy and ritual hierarchy sustains caste supremacy.
dialecticalTension: Synthesizes Ambedkarite anti-caste critique with feminist social history.

citations.author: Uma Chakravarti
citations.work: Conceptualising Brahmanical Patriarchy in Early India

label: Coined Brahmanical patriarchy to explain the structural fusion of caste and gender control
description: Chakravarti proved that patriarchy in South Asia cannot be analyzed independently of graded caste hierarchy, ritual purity, and agrarian property.
dialecticalTension: Replaces caste-blind universal patriarchy with a historically specific intersectional model.

label: Laid conceptual foundations for Rege’s Dalit feminist standpoint critique of savarna feminism
description: Chakravarti’s mapping of Brahmanical patriarchy catalyzed Rege’s project of centering Dalit women’s epistemologies and anti-caste feminism.
dialecticalTension: Moves from structural critique of Brahmanical patriarchy to Dalit feminist standpoint methodology.
